subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

A crocodile / was swimming / in a river.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. No error in the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The sentence is grammatically correct as it stands.

• The subject 'A crocodile' is singular, and it correctly uses the singular form of the verb 'was swimming'.

• The prepositional phrase 'in a river' correctly indicates the location of the action.

• There is no error with verb tense, subject-verb agreement, or prepositional use in the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *'A crocodile was swimming in a river.'*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 1 'A crocodile' is the subject of the sentence and is correctly used.

• Option 2 'was swimming' correctly matches the singular subject 'A crocodile' in number and is in the past continuous tense, indicating an action that was happening at a specific time in the past.

• Option 4 'in a river' correctly provides additional information about the location of the action, using the preposition 'in' to indicate where the swimming was taking place.
